entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَوِ ابْنِ كَثِيرٍ شَكٌّ مِنْهُ، أَوْ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ، فَقَالَ: «قَاتَلَ اللَّهُ الْيَهُودَ، حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّحُومُ فَحَرَّمُوا أَكْلَهَا، وَاسْتَحَلُّوا بَيْعَهَا، وَأَكَلُوا أَثْمَانَهَا، وَإِنَّ الَّذِي حَرَّمَ الْخَمْرَ حَرَّمَ بَيْعَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: From Muhammad b. Qays, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Ibn 'Umar, or Ibn Kathir (the doubt is from him), or someone else, about the sale of wine. He said: "May God fight the Jews! Fats were forbidden to them, so they forbade eating them but made lawful selling them, and ate their price. And the One who forbade wine has forbidden its sale."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ آكِلَ الرِّبَا وَمُوكِلَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from 'Ali ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ cursed the one who consumes usury (riba) and the one who gives it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّمَا الرِّبَا فِي النَّسِيئَةِ، وَمَا كَانَ يَدًا بِيَدٍ فَلَا بَأْسَ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Ata', from Ibn 'Abbas, from Usama b. Zayd ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "Usury is only in deferred [exchange]; what is hand to hand, there is no harm in it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الذَّهَبُ بِالذَّهَبِ مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا، وَالْفِضَّةُ بِالْفِضَّةِ وَزْنًا بِوَزْنٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا، وَالتَّمْرُ بِالتَّمْرِ مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا، وَالشَّعِيرُ بِالشَّعِيرِ مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا، وَالْمِلْحُ بِالْمِلْحِ مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «الذَّهَبُ بِالذَّهَبِ وَزْنًا بِوَزْنٍ يَدًا بِيَدٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا، وَالْحِنْطَةُ بِالْحِنْطَةِ كَيْلًا بِكَيْلٍ يَدًا بِيَدٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا، وَالتَّمْرُ بِالتَّمْرِ، وَالْمِلْحُ بِالْمِلْحِ كَيْلًا بِكَيْلٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Atiyya, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ؓ, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "Gold for gold, like for like, and the excess is usury; silver for silver, weight for weight, and the excess is usury; dates for dates, like for like, and the excess is usury; barley for barley, like for like, and the excess is usury; salt for salt, like for like, and the excess is usury." In another narration: "Gold for gold, weight for weight, hand to hand, and the excess is usury; wheat for wheat, measure for measure, hand to hand, and the excess is usury; dates for dates, and salt for salt, measure for measure, and the excess is usury."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ اشْتَرَى عَبْدَيْنِ بِعَبْدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ bought two slaves for one slave."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنِ اشْتَرَى طَعَامًا، فَلَا يَبِعْهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَوْفِيَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Amr b. Dinar, from Tawus, from Ibn 'Abbas ؓ, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has taken full possession of it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Nafi'', from Ibn 'Umar ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade the sale of uncertainty (gharar)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ،
entries.matn_ar: «عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُحَاقَلَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah al-Ansari ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "From the Prophet ﷺ, that he forbade muzabana and muhaqala."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ،
entries.matn_ar: «عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى أَنْ تُشْتَرَى ثَمَرَةٌ حَتَّى تُنْتِجَ»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "From the Prophet ﷺ: he forbade that fruit be bought until it yields."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ سُحَيْمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي النَّخْلِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلَاحُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: From Jabala b. Suhaym, from Ibn 'Umar ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade [selling] regarding date palms until their goodness appears."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا طَلَعَ النَّجْمُ رُفِعَتِ الْعَاهَاتُ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Ata', from Abu Hurayra ؓ, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "When the star rises, blights are lifted."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلًا مُؤَبَّرًا، أَوْ عَبْدًا لَهُ مَالٌ، فَالثَّمَرَةُ وَالْمَالُ لِلْبَائِعِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُشْتَرِي»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «مَنْ بَاعَ عَبْدًا وَلَهُ مَالٌ، فَالْمَالُ لِلْبَائِعِ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ، وَمَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلًا مُوَبَّرًا، فَثَمَرَتُهُ لِلْبَائِعِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah al-Ansari ؓ, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "Whoever sells a pollinated date palm, or a slave who has property, the fruit and the property belong to the seller, unless the buyer stipulates [otherwise]." In another narration: "Whoever sells a slave who has property, the property belongs to the seller, unless the purchaser stipulates [otherwise]; and whoever sells a pollinated date palm, its fruit belongs to the seller, unless the purchaser stipulates [otherwise]."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَنْ لَا أَتَّهِمُ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لَا يَسْتَامُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى سَوْمِ أَخِيهِ، وَلَا يَنْكِحُ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ، وَلَا تُنْكَحُ الْمَرْأَةُ عَلَى عَمَّتِهَا وَخَالَتِهَا، وَلَا تَسْأَلُ الْمَرْأَةُ طَلَاقَ أُخْتِهَا، لِتَكْفَأَ مَا فِي صَحْفَتِهَا، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ رَازِقُهَا، وَلَا تَبَايَعُوا بِإِلْقَاءِ الْحَجَرِ، وَإِذَا اسْتَأْجَرْتَ أَجِيرًا فَأَعْلِمْهُ أَجْرَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Ibrahim, from one whom I do not suspect, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Hurayra ؓ, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said:
entries.matn_en: "A man must not bid over his brother's bid, nor marry upon his brother's betrothal proposal, nor may a woman be married [together with] her paternal aunt or maternal aunt, nor may a woman ask for her sister's divorce in order to empty what is in her dish, for God is the One who provides for her. And do not trade by throwing the stone, and when you hire a worker, inform him of his wage."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ مَعْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ: "اشْتَرُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ، قَالُوا: وَكَيْفَ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: يَقُولُونَ: بِعْنَا إِلَى مَقَاسِمِنَا وَمَغانِمِنَا"
entries.isnad_en: From Ma'n b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud, from 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud ؓ, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said:
entries.matn_en: "Buy from God." They said: "And how is that, O Messenger of God?" He said: "They say: 'Sell [to] us until [the time of] our shares and our spoils.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي ثَمَنِ كَلْبِ الصَّيْدِ»
entries.isnad_en: From al-Haytham b. Habib, from 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ granted a concession regarding the price of a hunting dog."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، عَنْ مَنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعَثَ عَتَّابَ بْنَ أُسَيْدٍ إِلَى أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ، فَقَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «انْهَهُمْ عَنْ شَرْطَيْنِ فِي بَيْعٍ، وَعَنْ بَيْعٍ وَسَلَفٍ، وَعَنْ رِبْحٍ مَا لَمْ يَضْمَنْ، وَعَنْ بَيْعٍ مَا لَمْ يُقْبَضْ»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu Ya'fur, from one who narrated to him, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr ؓ, from the Prophet ﷺ:
entries.matn_en: He sent 'Attab b. Asid to the people of Mecca and said: "Forbid them two conditions in one sale, a sale combined with a loan, profit on what one has not [yet] taken liability for, and the sale of what has not been taken into possession."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ قَزْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا يَبْتَاعُ أَحَدُكُمْ عَبْدًا، وَلَا أَمَةً فِيهِ شَرْطٌ، فَإِنَّهُ عُقِدَ فِي الرِّقِّ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Abd al-Malik, from Qaza'a, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ؓ, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "Let none of you buy a male slave or a female slave with a condition attached, for it has been contracted in bondage."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ الْأَشْجَعِيِّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي رِبْعِيُّ بْنُ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar:
"يُؤْتَى بِعَبْدٍ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، فَيَقُولُ: أَيْ رَبِّ، مَا عَمِلْتُ إِلَّا خَيْرًا مَا أَرَدْتُ بِهِ إِلَّا لِقَاءَكَ، فَكُنْتُ أُوَسِّعُ عَلَى الْمُوسِرِ، وَأُنْدِرُ عَنِ الْمُعْسِرِ، فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: أَنَا أَحَقُّ بِذَلِكَ مِنْكَ، فَتَجَاوَزُوا عَنْ عَبْدِي".

فَقَالَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ: وَأَشْهَدُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: From Abu Malik al-Ashja'i, who said:
entries.matn_en:
Rib'i b. Hirash narrated to me, from Hudhayfa, who said: "A servant will be brought before God Almighty on the Day of Resurrection, and he will say: 'My Lord, I did nothing but good; I intended by it nothing but meeting You. I used to be generous with the well-off and give respite to the one in hardship.' God Almighty will say: 'I am more deserving of that than you. So overlook [the faults of] My servant.'"

Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari said: "And I testify, upon the Messenger of God ﷺ, that he heard it from him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ شَدَّدَ عَلَى أُمَّتِي فِي التَّقَاضِي، إِذَا كَانَ مُعْسِرًا شَدَّدَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ فِي قَبْرِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Isma'il, from Abu Salih, from Umm Hani', who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "Whoever is harsh upon my community in demanding repayment, when [the debtor] is in hardship, God Almighty will be harsh upon him in his grave."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ غَشَّ فِي الْبَيْعِ وَالشِّرَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Abd Allah, from Ibn 'Umar ؓ, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said:
entries.matn_en: "He is not one of us who cheats in selling and buying."

entries.label: Entry
entries.matn_ar: حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، وَأَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ: «أَوَّلُ مَنْ ضَرَبَ الدِّينَارَ تُبَّعٌ، وَهُوَ أَسْعَدُ بْنُ كَرْبٍ، وَأَوَّلُ مَنْ ضَرَبَ الدَّرَاهِمَ تُبَّعٌ الْأَصْغَرُ، وَأَوَّلُ مَنْ ضَرَبَ الْفُلُوسَ، وَأَدَارَهَا فِي أَيْدِي النَّاسِ نَمْرُودُ بْنُ كَنْعَانَ»
entries.isnad_en: Hammad, from his father and Abu Sulayman, said:
entries.matn_en: "The first to mint the Dinar was Tubba', who is As'ad b. Karib; the first to mint dirhams was Tubba' the Younger; and the first to mint fulus [copper coins] and circulate them in the hands of the people was Nimrod b. Canaan."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا:
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ اشْتَرَى مِنَ الْيَهُودِيِّ طَعَامًا، وَرَهَنَهُ دِرْعًا»
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ bought food from a Jew and pawned a coat of armor with him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ ابْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «الْجَارُ أَحَقُّ بِشُفْعَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Muhammad said: Ibn Sa'id ibn Ja'far wrote to me, from Sulayman b. 'Abd Allah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "The neighbor is more deserving of his right of pre-emption."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar:
أَرَادَ سَعْدٌ بَيْعَ دَارٍ لَهُ، فَقَالَ لِجَارِهِ: خُذْهَا بِسَبْعِ مِائَةٍ، فَإِنِّي قَدْ أَعْطَيْتُ بِهَا ثَمَانِ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، وَلَكِنْ أَعْطَيْتُكَهَا، لِأَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ: «الْجَارُ أَحَقُّ بِشُفْعَتِهِ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ: عَرَضَ عَلَيَّ سَعْدٌ بَيْتًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ: خُذْهُ، أَمَا إِنِّي قَدْ أُعْطِيتُ بِهِ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا تُعْطِينِي، وَلَكِنَّكَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ، فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ: «الْجَارُ أَحَقُّ بِشُفْعَتِهِ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ، عَنْ رَافِعٍ مَوْلَى سَعْدٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ يَعْنِي: سَعْدًا: آخُذُ هَذَا الْبَيْتَ بِأَرْبَعِ مِائَةٍ: فَيَقُولُ: أَمَا إِنِّي أُعْطِيتُ ثَمَانِ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، وَلَكِنْ أَعْطَيْتُكَهُ، لِحَدِيثٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ: «الْجَارُ أَحَقُّ بِشُفْعَتِهِ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ: أَنَّهُ عَرَضَ بَيْتًا لَهُ عَلَى جَارِهِ بِأَرْبَعِ مِائَةٍ، وَقَالَ: وَقَدْ أُعْطِيتُ ثَمَانِ مِائَةٍ، وَلَكِنْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ: «الْجَارُ أَحَقُّ بِشُفْعَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Abd al-Karim, from al-Miswar b. Makhrama, who said:
entries.matn_en:
Sa'd wished to sell a house of his, and he said to his neighbor: "Take it for seven hundred, for I have been offered eight hundred dirhams for it, but I am giving it to you because I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'The neighbor is more deserving of his right of pre-emption.'"

In another narration, from al-Miswar, from Rafi' b. Khadij, who said: Sa'd offered me a house, and said to him: "Take it. I have been offered more for it than what you are offering me, but you are more deserving of it, for I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'The neighbor is more deserving of his right of pre-emption.'"

In another narration, from al-Miswar, from Rafi', the freed slave of Sa'd, that he said to a man, meaning Sa'd: "I will take this house for four hundred." He replied: "I was offered eight hundred dirhams, but I am giving it to you because of a hadith I heard from the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said: 'The neighbor is more deserving of his right of pre-emption.'"

In another narration, from Sa'd b. Malik: that he offered a house of his to his neighbor for four hundred, and said: "I have been offered eight hundred, but I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'The neighbor is more deserving of his right of pre-emption.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِذَا أَرَادَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَضَعَ خَشَبَةً فِي حَائِطِهِ فَلَا يَمْنَعُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Ali b. al-Aqmar, from Masruq, from 'A'isha ؓ, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "If one of you wishes to place a beam [of wood] in his wall, let him [i.e., the wall's owner] not prevent him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الْمُخَابَرَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade mukhabara."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ مَرَّ بِحَائِطٍ فَأَعْجَبَهُ، فَقَالَ، "لِمَنْ هَذَا؟ فَقُلْتُ: لِي، فَقَالَ: مِنْ أَيْنَ لَكَ هُوَ؟ قُلْتُ: اسْتَأْجَرْتُهُ، قَالَ: لا تَسْتَأْجِرْهُ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْهُ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَرَّ بِحَائِطٍ فَقَالَ: "لِمَنْ هَذَا؟ فَقُلْتُ: لِي، وَقَدِ اسْتَأْجَرْتُهُ، قَالَ: فَلَا تَسْتَأْجِرْهُ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْهُ"
entries.isnad_en: From Abu Husayn, from Rafi' b. Khadij, from the Prophet ﷺ:
entries.matn_en:
that he passed by an orchard and it pleased him, and he said: "To whom does this belong?" I said: "To me." He said: "How did you come by it?" I said: "I rented it." He said: "Do not rent it for a portion of its [produce]."

In another narration: The Prophet ﷺ passed by an orchard and said: "To whom does this belong?" I said: "To me, and I have rented it." He said: "Then do not rent it for a portion of its [produce]."

sections.title_en: The Book of Virtues and Characteristics (Faḍāʾil and Shamāʾil)

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، وَرَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قُبِضَ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلَاثٍ وَسِتِّينَ، وَقُبِضَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلَاثٍ وَسِتِّينَ، وَقُبِضَ عُمَرُ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلَاثٍ وَسِتِّينَ»
entries.isnad_en: From al-Haytham and Rabi'a, from Anas ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ was taken [in death] at the age of sixty-three, Abu Bakr was taken at the age of sixty-three, and 'Umar was taken at the age of sixty-three."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «بُعِثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى رَأْسِ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً، فَأَقَامَ بِمَكَّةَ عَشْرًا، وَبِالْمَدِينَةِ عَشْرًا، وَتُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَمَا فِي لِحْيَتِهِ وَرَأْسِهِ عِشْرُونَ شَعْرَةً بَيْضَاءَ»
entries.isnad_en: From Yahya b. Sa'id, from Anas ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ was sent [as a prophet] at the head of forty years. He stayed in Mecca ten years and in Medina ten years. The Messenger of God ﷺ died with not twenty white hairs in his beard and head."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُعْرَفُ بِرِيحِ الطِّيبِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The Prophet ﷺ was recognized by the scent of perfume."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يُعْرَفُ بِاللَّيْلِ إِذَا أَقْبَلَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ بِرِيحِ الطِّيبِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Ibrahim, from 'Alqama, from 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ was recognized at night, when he approached the mosque, by the scent of perfume."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ لِي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ دَيْنٌ فَقَضَانِي، وَزَادَنِي»
entries.isnad_en: From Muharib, from Ibn 'Umar ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "I was owed a debt by the Prophet ﷺ, and he repaid me and gave me extra."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا مَسَسْتُ بِيَدِي خَزًّا وَلَا حَرِيرًا أَلْيَنَ مِنْ كَفِّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: أَيْ عَنِ الْإِمَامِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ كَمَا فِي الشَّرْحِ، قَالَ: «مَا رُؤِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهُ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَادًّا رُكْبَتَيْهِ بَيْنَ جَلِيسٍ لَهُ قَطُّ»
entries.isnad_en: From Ibrahim, from Anas b. Malik ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "I never touched with my hand any khazz [silk-wool fabric] or silk softer than the palm of the Messenger of God ﷺ." In another narration, that is, from the Imam [Abu Hanifa], from Ibrahim b. Muhammad b. al-Muntashir, from Anas, as in the commentary, he said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ was never seen stretching out his knees in front of one sitting with him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا عَنْ خُلُقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ: «أَمَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ؟!»
entries.isnad_en: From Ibrahim, from his father, from Masruq, that he asked 'A'isha ؓ about the character of the Messenger of God ﷺ, and she said:
entries.matn_en: "Do you not read the Qur'an?!"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الْمَمْلُوكِ، وَيَرْكَبُ الْحِمَارَ»
entries.isnad_en: From Muslim, from Anas ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ would answer the invitation of a slave and would ride a donkey."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى بَيَاضِ قَدَمَيْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، حَيْثُ أَتَى الصَّلَاةَ فِي مَرَضِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "It is as though I am looking at the whiteness of the feet of the Messenger of God ﷺ when he came to the prayer during his illness."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا:
entries.matn_ar: "أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَمَّا مَرِضَ الْمَرَضَ الَّذِي قُبِضَ فِيهِ، اسْتَحَلَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي بَيْتِي، فَأَحْلَلْنَ لَهُ، قَالَتْ: فَلَمَّا سَمِعْتُ ذَلِكَ قُمْتُ مُسْرِعَةً فَكَنَسْتُ بَيْتِي، وَلَيْسَ لِي خَادِمٌ، وَفَرَشْتُ لَهُ فِرَاشًا حَشْوُ مِرْفَقَتِهِ الْإِذْخِرُ، فَأَتَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يُهَادِي بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ، حَتَّى وُضِعَ عَلَى فِرَاشِي"
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "When the Prophet ﷺ fell ill with the illness in which he was taken, he asked to be released [from his rotation] so as to be in my house, and they [his wives] released him. She said: When I heard that, I got up hurriedly and swept my house, and I had no servant, and I spread for him a bed whose cushion was stuffed with idhkhir [a fragrant grass]. Then the Messenger of God ﷺ came, supported between two men, until he was laid on my bed."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ،
entries.matn_ar:
"أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَأَى مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خِفَّةً، فَاسْتَأْذَنَهُ إِلَى امْرَأَتِهِ بِنْتِ خَارِجَةَ، وَكَانَتْ فِي حَوَائِطِ الْأَنْصَارِ، وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ رَاحَةَ الْمَوْتِ وَلَا يَشْعُرُ، فَأَذِنَ، ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ، فَأَصْبَحَ، فَجَعَلَ يَرَى النَّاسَ يَتَرَامَوْنَ، فَأَمَرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ غُلَامًا يَسْتَمِعُ، ثُمَّ يُخْبِرُهُ، فَقَالَ: أَسْمَعُهُمْ يَقُولُونَ: مَاتَ مُحَمَّدٌ، فَاشْتَدَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: وَاقَطْعَ ظَهْرَاهُ، فَمَا بَلَغَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ الْمَسْجِدَ، حَتَّى ظَنُّوا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْلُغْ، وَأَرْجَفَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ، فَقَالُوا: لَوْ كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيًّا لَمْ يَمُتْ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: لَا أَسْمَعُ رَجُلًا يَقُولُ: مَاتَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، إِلَّا ضَرَبْتُهُ بِالسَّيْفِ.

فَكَفُّوا لِذَلِكَ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُسَجًّى، كَشَفَ الثَّوْبَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، ثُمَّ جَعَلَ يَلْثَمُهُ، فَقَالَ: مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُذِيقَكَ الْمَوْتَ مَرَّتَيْنِ، أَنْتَ أَكْرَمُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ مُحَمَّدًا فَإِنَّ مُحَمَّدًا قَدْ مَاتَ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ لَا يَمُوتُ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: {وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ أَفَإِنْ مَاتَ أَوْ قُتِلَ انْقَلَبْتُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِكُمْ وَمَنْ يَنْقَلِبْ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ فَلَنْ يَضُرَّ اللَّهَ شَيْئًا وَسَيَجْزِي اللَّهُ الشَّاكِرِينَ} [آل عمران: 144].

قَالَ: فَقَالَ عُمَرُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: لَكَأَنَّا لَمْ نَقْرَأْهَا قَبْلَهَا قَطُّ، فَقَالَ النَّاسُ مِثْلَ مَقَالَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ وَقِرَاءَتِهِ.

وَمَاتَ لَيْلَةَ الْإِثْنَيْنِ، فَمَكَثَ لَيْلَتَيْنِ وَيَوْمَيْنِ، وَدُفِنَ يَوْمَ الثُّلَاثَاءِ، فَكَانَ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَأَوْسُ بْنُ خَوْلِيٍّ يَصُبَّانِ عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ وَعَلِيٌّ وَالْفَضْلُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا يُغَسِّلَانِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ"
entries.isnad_en: From Yazid, from Anas ؓ:
entries.matn_en:
"Abu Bakr saw some lightness [improvement] in the Messenger of God ﷺ, so he asked his permission [to go] to his wife, the daughter of Kharija, who was in the orchards of the Ansar. That was the respite before death, and he did not realize it. So he permitted him. Then the Messenger of God ﷺ died that night. [Abu Bakr] woke in the morning and began to see the people agitated, so Abu Bakr ؓ ordered a boy to listen and then report to him. He said: 'I hear them saying: Muhammad has died.' So Abu Bakr ؓ hurried, saying: 'Oh, my back is broken!' Abu Bakr ؓ had not yet reached the mosque when they thought he would not make it. The hypocrites spread rumors and said: 'If Muhammad were a prophet, he would not have died.' 'Umar ؓ said: 'I will not hear a man say that Muhammad ﷺ has died without striking him with the sword.'

So they refrained because of that. When Abu Bakr ؓ came, with the Prophet ﷺ lying covered, he uncovered the cloth from his face and began kissing him, and said: 'God would not make you taste death twice. You are too honored with God for that.' Then he said: 'O people, whoever worshipped Muhammad, Muhammad has died; and whoever worshipped the Lord of Muhammad, the Lord of Muhammad does not die.' Then he recited: {Muhammad is not but a messenger. [Other] messengers have passed on before him. So if he was to die or be killed, would you turn back on your heels? And he who turns back on his heels will never harm God at all; and God will reward the grateful.} [Surat Al 'Imran: 144].

He said: 'Umar ؓ said: 'It is as though we had never read it before.' And the people said the same as Abu Bakr's ؓ statement and recitation.

He died on the night of Monday, remained for two nights and two days, and was buried on Tuesday. Usama b. Zayd and Aws b. Khawli poured water over him, while 'Ali and al-Fadl ؓ washed him ﷺ."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الزَّعْرَاءِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "اقْتَدُوا بِاللَّذِينَ مِنْ بَعْدِي: أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ"
entries.isnad_en: From Salama, from Abu al-Zar'a, from Ibn Mas'ud ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "Follow the two who come after me: Abu Bakr and 'Umar."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "اقْتَدُوا بِاللَّذِينَ مِنْ بَعْدِي: أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُثْمَانَ، وَاهْتَدُوا بِهُدَى عُمَرَ، وَتَمَسَّكُوا بِعَهْدِ ابْنِ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ"
entries.isnad_en: From 'Abd al-Malik, from Rib'i, from Hudhayfa b. al-Yaman, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "Follow the two who come after me: Abu Bakr and 'Uthman; be guided by the guidance of 'Umar; and hold fast to the covenant of Ibn Umm 'Abd."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ كَثِيرٍ:
entries.matn_ar:
أَنَّ عُمَرَ مَرَّ بِعُثْمَانَ وَهُوَ حَزِينٌ قَالَ: مَا يَحْزُنُكَ؟ قَالَ: أَلَا أَحْزَنْ، وَقَدِ انْقَطَعَ الصِّهْرُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَذَلِكَ حَدَثَانَ مَاتَتْ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: أُزَوِّجُكَ حَفْصَةَ ابْنَتِي، قَالَ: حَتَّى أَسْتَأْمِرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: "هَلْ لَكَ أَنْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى صِهْرٍ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنْ عُثْمَانَ، وَأَدُلُّ عُثْمَانَ عَلَى صِهْرٍ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْكَ، فَقَالَ: زَوِّجْنِي حَفْصَةَ، وَأُزَوِّجُ عُثْمَانَ بِنْتِي، أَيْ: عُمَرَ.

فَقَالَ: فَفَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ"
entries.isnad_en: From al-Haytham, from Musa b. Kathir:
entries.matn_en:
'Umar passed by 'Uthman, who was sad. He said: "What saddens you?" He said: "Should I not be sad, when the in-law relationship between me and the Messenger of God ﷺ has been cut?" This was shortly after the daughter of the Messenger of God ﷺ, who had been married to him, died. 'Umar said to him: "I will marry you to Hafsa, my daughter." He said: "[Let me wait] until I consult the Messenger of God ﷺ." The Messenger of God said to him: "Would you like me to direct you to an in-law who is better for you than 'Uthman, and direct 'Uthman to an in-law who is better for him than you?" He said: "Marry me to Hafsa, and I will marry my daughter to 'Uthman," that is, ['Umar speaking].

He said: The Messenger of God ﷺ did so.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ حَبَّةَ الْعُرَنِيِّ وَهُوَ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ عَلِيٍّ كَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَجْهَهُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ»
entries.isnad_en: From Salama, from Habba al-'Urani, who is al-Hamdani, one of the companions of 'Ali, ؓ, who said: I heard 'Ali ؓ say:
entries.matn_en: "I am the first who accepted Islam."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَظَرَ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ كَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَجْهَهُ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ، فَرَآهُ جَائِعًا، فَقَالَ: "يَا عَلِيُّ، مَا أَجَاعَكَ؟ قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي لَمْ أَشْبَعْ مُنْذُ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَبْشِرْ بِالْجَنَّةِ"
entries.isnad_en: From Isma'il, from Abu Salih, from Umm Hani':
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ looked at 'Ali, ؓ, one day and saw that he was hungry. He said: "O 'Ali, what has made you hungry?" He said: "O Messenger of God, I have not been filled since such-and-such a time." He ﷺ said: "Receive glad tidings of Paradise."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar:
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «سَيِّدُ الشُّهَدَاءِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، ثُمَّ رَجُلٌ دَخَلَ إِلَى إِمَامٍ، فَأَمَرَهُ وَنَهَاهُ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «سَيُّدُ الشُّهَدَاءِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، وَرَجُلٌ قَامَ إِلَى إِمَامٍ جَائِرٍ، فَأَمَرَهُ وَنَهَاهُ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en:
"The master of the martyrs on the Day of Resurrection is Hamza b. 'Abd al-Muttalib, then a man who went to a ruler and commanded him and forbade him."

In another narration: "The master of the martyrs on the Day of Resurrection is Hamza b. 'Abd al-Muttalib, and a man who stood up to an unjust ruler and commanded him and forbade him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "مَنْ يَأْتِينَا بِالْخَبَرِ؟ لَيْلَةَ الْأَحْزَابِ، فَيَنْطَلِقُ الزُّبَيْرُ فَيَأْتِيهِ بِالْخَبَرِ، كَانَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ حَوَارِيٌّ، وَحَوَاريِّي الزُّبَيْرُ»
entries.isnad_en: From Muhammad b. al-Munkadir, from Jabir ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said on the night of al-Ahzab [the Confederates]: "Who will bring us the news?" And al-Zubayr would go and bring him the news. This happened three times. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Every prophet has a disciple (hawari), and my disciple is al-Zubayr."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ:
entries.matn_ar:
أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ سَمَرَا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ، قَالَ: فَخَرَجَا وَخَرَجَ، فَمَرُّوا بِابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، وَهُوَ يَقْرَأُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَا نَزَلَ، فَلْيَقْرَأْهُ عَلَى قِرَاءَةِ ابْنِ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ، وَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ لَهُ: سَلْ تُعْطَهْ"، فَأَتَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ يُبَشِّرَانِهِ، فَسَبَقَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ عُمَرَ إِلَيْهِ، فَبَشَّرَهُ وَأَخْبَرَهُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَدْ أَمَرَهُ بِالدُّعَاءِ، فَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا دَائِمًا لَا يَزُولُ، وَنَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ، وَمُرَافَقَةَ نَبِيِّكَ فِي جَنَّةِ الْخُلْدِ، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ سَمَرا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَخَرَجَا وَخَرَجَا مَعَهُمَا، فَمَرُّوا بِابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وَهُوَ يَقْرَأُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ غَضًّا كَمَا أُنْزِلَ، فَلْيَقْرَأْهُ عَلَى قِرَاءَةِ ابْنِ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ، وَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ: سَلْ تُعْطَهْ".

وَذَكَرَ تَمَامَ الْأَوَّلِ
entries.isnad_en: From al-Haytham, from a man, from 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud ؓ:
entries.matn_en:
Abu Bakr and 'Umar conversed at night with the Messenger of God ﷺ one night. He said: They left, and he [the Prophet] left, and they passed by Ibn Mas'ud, who was reciting. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever would like to recite the Qur'an as it was revealed, let him recite it according to the recitation of Ibn Umm 'Abd." And he kept saying to him: "Ask, and you will be given." Abu Bakr and 'Umar came to him to give him the good news, and Abu Bakr got to him before 'Umar, gave him the good news, and told him that the Prophet ﷺ had ordered him to supplicate. He said: "O God, I ask You for a lasting faith that does not fade, bliss that does not run out, and companionship with Your Prophet in the Garden of Eternity." In another narration, from al-Haytham, from 'Abd Allah: Abu Bakr and 'Umar conversed with the Prophet ﷺ, then they left and [the Prophet] left with them, and they passed by Ibn Mas'ud, who was reciting. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever loves to recite the Qur'an fresh, as it was revealed, let him recite it according to the recitation of Ibn Umm 'Abd." And he kept saying: "Ask, and you will be given."

And he mentioned the rest as in the first.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ إذَا دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَيْتَهُ، أَرْسَلَ وَالِدَتَهُ أُمَّ عَبْدٍ تَنْظُرُ إِلَى هَدْيِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَدَلِّهِ، فَتُخْبِرُهُ بِذَلِكَ، فَيَتَشَبَّهُ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Awn, from his father, from 'Abd Allah:
entries.matn_en: "Whenever the Messenger of God ﷺ entered his house, he [i.e., 'Abd Allah] would send his mother, Umm 'Abd, to observe the conduct of the Prophet ﷺ and his demeanor, and she would report that to him, and he would imitate him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ:
entries.matn_ar:
«أَنَّهُ كَانَ صَاحِبَ خَصْفِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «صَاحِبَ عَصَا رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «كَانَ صَاحِبَ رِدَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «كَانَ صَاحِبَ الرَّاحِلَةِ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «كَانَ صَاحِبَ سِوَاكِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَصَاحِبَ الْمَيْضَأَةِ، وَصَاحِبَ النَّعْلَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Awn, from his father, from 'Abd Allah:
entries.matn_en:
"He was the keeper of the sandal-stitching [or: mending] of the Messenger of God ﷺ." In another narration: "the keeper of the staff of the Messenger of God ﷺ."

In another narration: "He was the keeper of the cloak of the Messenger of God ﷺ."

In another narration: "He was the keeper of the riding animal of the Messenger of God ﷺ."

In another narration: "He was the keeper of the tooth-stick of the Messenger of God ﷺ, the keeper of the ablution vessel, and the keeper of the two sandals."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ مَعْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "مَا كَذَبْتُ مُنْذُ أَسْلَمْتُ إِلَّا كَذِبَةً وَاحِدَةً، كُنْتُ أَرْحَلُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَتَى رَحَّالٌ مِنَ الطَّائِفِ، فَسَأَلَنِي: أَيُّ الرَّاحِلَةِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ فَقُلْتُ: الطَّائِفِيَّةُ الْمَكِّيَّةُ، وَكَانَ يَكْرَهُهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهُ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَلَمَّا أَتَى بِهَا قَالَ: مَنْ رَحَلَ لَنَا هَذِهِ؟ قَالُوا: رَحَّالُكَ، قَالَ: مُرُوا ابْنَ أَمِّ عَبْدٍ، فَلْيُرَحِّلْ لَنَا، فَأُعِيدَتْ إِلَيَّ الرَّاحِلَةُ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: "إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ جِيءَ بِرَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الطَّائِفِ، قَالَ: فَجَاءَنِي الطَّائِفِيُّ، فَقَالَ: أَيُّ الرَّاحِلَةِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ؟ قُلْتُ الطَّائِفِيَّةُ الْمَكِّيَّةُ، فَخَرَجَ، فَقَالَ: مَنْ صَاحِبُ هَذِهِ الرَّاحِلَةِ؟ قِيلَ: الطَّائِفِيُّ، قَالَ: لَا حَاجَةَ لَنَا بِهَا"
entries.isnad_en: From Ma'n, from Ibn Mas'ud ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "I have not lied since I accepted Islam except one lie. I used to saddle [the mount] for the Prophet ﷺ. A saddler from al-Ta'if came and asked me: 'Which riding animal is most beloved to the Messenger of God ﷺ?' I said: 'The Ta'ifi-Makkan one.' But the Messenger of God ﷺ disliked it. When he [the saddler] brought it, [the Prophet] said: 'Who saddled this for us?' They said: 'Your saddler.' He said: 'Tell Ibn Umm 'Abd to saddle for us.' So the mount was returned to me." In another narration, 'Abd Allah said: "A man from the people of al-Ta'if was brought to the Prophet ﷺ. He said: the Ta'ifi came to me and said: 'Which riding animal is most beloved to him?' I said: 'The Ta'ifi-Makkan one.' [The Prophet] came out and said: 'Whose is this riding animal?' It was said: 'The Ta'ifi's.' He said: 'We have no need of it.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَا كَذَبْتُ مُنْذُ أَسْلَمْتُ إِلَّا وَاحِدَةً: كُنْتُ أَرْحَلُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَتَى رَحَّالٌ مِنَ الطَّائِفِ، فَقَالَ: أَيُّ الرَّاحِلَةِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ قُلْتُ: الطَّائِفِيَّةُ الْمَكِّيَّةُ، قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: وَكَانَ يَكْرَهُهَا، فَلَمَّا رَحَلَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَتَى بِهَا، قَالَ: "مَنْ رَحَلَ لَنَا هَذِهِ الرَّاحِلَةَ؟ قَالَ: رَحَّالُكَ الَّذِي أَتَيْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الطَّائِفِ، فَقَالَ: رُدُّوا الرِّحَالَةَ لِابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ"
entries.isnad_en: From al-Haytham, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq, from 'Abd Allah ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "I have not lied since I accepted Islam except once. I used to saddle for the Messenger of God ﷺ. A saddler from al-Ta'if came and said: 'Which riding animal is most beloved to the Messenger of God ﷺ?' I said: 'The Ta'ifi-Makkan one.'" Ibn Mas'ud said: "And he disliked it. When [the saddler] saddled for the Messenger of God ﷺ and brought it, [the Prophet] said: 'Who saddled this riding animal for us?' He said: 'Your saddler whom you brought from al-Ta'if.' He said: 'Return the saddle to Ibn Mas'ud.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَدَلِيِّ، عَنْ خُزَيْمَةَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ مَرَّ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَمَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ يَجْحَدُ بَيْعَهُ، فَقَالَ خُزَيْمَةَ: أَشْهَدُ لَقَدْ بِعْتَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "مِنْ أَيْنَ عَلِمْتَهُ؟ قَالَ: تَجِيئُنَا بِالْوَحْيِ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَنُصَدِّقُكَ، قَالَ: فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَهَادَتَهُ بِشَهَادَةِ رَجُلَيْنِ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «أَجَازَ شَهَادَتَهُ بِشَهَادَةِ رَجُلَيْنِ حَتَّى مَاتَ»
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Abu 'Abd Allah al-Jadali, from Khuzayma:
entries.matn_en: that he passed by the Messenger of God ﷺ, and with the Messenger of God ﷺ was a Bedouin who was denying his sale. Khuzayma said: "I testify that you sold it." The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "How did you know?" He said: "You bring us revelation from heaven and we believe you." He said: The Messenger of God ﷺ made his testimony equal to the testimony of two men. In another narration: "He allowed his testimony to count as the testimony of two men until he died."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «بُشِّرَتْ خَدِيجَةُ بِبَيْتٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ، لَا صَخَبَ فِيهَا وَلَا نَصَبَ»
entries.isnad_en: From Yahya b. Sa'id, from Anas b. Malik, who said:
entries.matn_en: "Khadija was given glad tidings of a house in Paradise, in which there is no clamor and no toil."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيِّ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "إِنَّهُ لَيُهَوِّنُ عَلَيَّ الْمَوْتَ أَنِّي رَأَيْتُكِ زَوْجَتِي فِي الْجَنَّةِ، ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ، وَقَالَ: هُوِّنَ عَلَيَّ الْمَوْتُ، لِأَنِّي رَأَيْتُ عَائِشَةَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ"
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Ibrahim al-Nakha'i, from 'A'isha ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "Death is made easy for me because I saw you as my wife in Paradise." Then he turned and said: "Death was made easy for me because I saw 'A'isha in Paradise."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: "لَقَدْ كُنَّ فِيَّ خِلَالٌ سَبْعٌ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: كُنْتُ أَحَبَّهُنَّ إِلَيْهِ أبًا، وَأَحَبَّهُنَّ إِلَيْهِ نَفْسًا، وَتَزَوَّجَنِي بِكْرًا، وَمَا تَزَوَّجَنِي حَتَّى أَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ بِصُورَتِي، وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَمَا رَآهُ أَحَدٌ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ غَيْرِي، وَكَانَ يَأْتِيهِ جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَأَنَا فِي شِعَارِهِ، وَلَقَدْ نَزَلَ فِيَّ عُذْرٌ كَادَ أَنْ يَهْلِكَ فِئَامٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَلَقَدْ قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي بَيْتِي وَلَيْلَتِي وَيَوْمِي، وَبَيْنَ سَحْرِي وَنَحْرِي"
entries.isnad_en: From al-Sha'bi, from 'A'isha ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "There were in me seven qualities that none of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ had: I was the most beloved of them to him in terms of father, and the most beloved of them to him in person; he married me as a virgin; he did not marry me until Gabriel ؑ came to him with my image; I saw Gabriel ؑ, and no other woman saw him but me; Gabriel ؑ would come to him while I was in his shi'ar [garment/bedcover]; an exoneration was revealed concerning me, over which a multitude of people nearly perished; and the Messenger of God ﷺ was taken in my house, on my night and my day, between my lung and my throat."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَوْنِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: "فِيَّ سَبْعُ خِصَالٍ لَيْسَتْ فِي وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: تَزَوَّجَنِي وَأَنَا بِكْرٌ، وَلَمْ يَتَزَوَّجْ أَحَدًا مِنْ نِسَائِهِ بِكْرًا غَيْرِي، وَنَزَلَ جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ بِصُورَتِي، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَنِي، وَلَمْ يَنْزِلْ بِصَورَةِ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ غَيْرِي، وَأَرَانِي جِبْرِيلَ، وَلَمْ يُرِهِ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ غَيْرِي، وَكُنْتُ مِنْ أَحَبِّهِنَّ إِلَيْهِ نَفْسًا وَأَبًا، وَنَزَلَتْ فِيَّ آيَاتٌ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، كَادَ أَنْ يَهْلِكَ فِئَامٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَمَاتَ فِي لَيْلَتِي وَيَوْمِي، وَتُوُفِّيَ بَيْنَ سَحْرِي وَنَحْرِي"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: "إِنَّ فِيَّ سَبْعَ خِصَالٍ مَا هُنَّ فِي وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ: تَزَوَّجَنِي بِكْرًا وَلَمْ يَتَزَوَّجْ بِكْرًا غَيْرِي، وَأَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ بِصُورَتِي، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَنِي، وَلَمْ يَأْتِهِ جِبْرِيلُ بِصُورَةِ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ غَيْرِي، وَمِنْ أَحَبِّهِنَّ إِلَيْهِ نَفْسًا وَأَبًا، وَأُنْزِلَ فِيَّ عُذْرٌ، كَادَ يَهْلِكَ فِئَامٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَمَاتَ فِي يَوْمِي وَلَيْلَتِي، وَبَيْنَ سَحْرِي وَنَحْرِي، وَأَرَانِي جِبْرِيلَ، وَلَمْ يُرِهِ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ غَيْرِي"
entries.isnad_en: From 'Awn, from 'Amir al-Sha'bi, from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: "In me are seven qualities that are in none of the wives of the Messenger of God ﷺ: he married me when I was a virgin, and he did not marry any of his wives as a virgin other than me; Gabriel ؑ came down with my image before he married me, and did not come down with the image of any of his wives other than me; Gabriel showed me [to him]..." "...and he did not show him to any of his wives other than me; I was among the most beloved of them to him in person and father; verses of the Qur'an were revealed concerning me, over which a multitude of people nearly perished; and he died on my night and my day, and he passed away between my lung and my throat." In another narration, she said: "In me are seven qualities that are in none of his wives: he married me as a virgin and did not marry a virgin other than me; Gabriel came to him with my image before he married me, and Gabriel did not come to him with the image of any of his wives other than me; I was among the most beloved of them to him in person and father; an exoneration was revealed concerning me, over which a multitude of people nearly perished; he died on my day and my night, between my lung and my throat; and Gabriel was shown to me, and he was not shown to any of his wives other than me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ: "أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا حَدَّثَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَتْنِي الصِّدِّيقَةُ بِنْتُ الصِّدِّيقِ، الْمُبَرَّأَةُ، حَبِيبَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ"
entries.isnad_en: From Ibrahim, from Masruq:
entries.matn_en: "When he narrated from 'A'isha ؓ, he would say: 'The truthful one, daughter of the truthful one, the one declared innocent, the beloved of the Messenger of God Almighty, ﷺ, narrated to me.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فِي مَرَضِهَا، فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِ: إِنِّي أَجِدُ غَمًّا أَوْ كَرْبًا، فَانْصَرِفْ، فَقَالَ لِلرَّسُولِ: مَا أَنَا بِالَّذِي يَنْصَرِفُ حَتَّى أَدْخُلَ، فَأَذِنَتْ لَهُ، فَقَالَتْ: إِنِّي أَجِدُ غَمًّا وَكَرْبًا، وَأَنَا مُشْفِقَةٌ مِمَّا أَخَافُ أَنْ أُهْجَمَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ لَهَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: فَوَاللَّهِ، لَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ: «عَائِشَةُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ»، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَكْرَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُزَوِّجَهُ حَمْرَةً مِنْ حُمَرِ جَهَنَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ: فَرَّجْتَ عَنِّي فَرَّجَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْكَ"
entries.isnad_en: From al-Haytham, from 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas, that he asked permission to enter upon 'A'isha during her illness. She sent word to him:
entries.matn_en: "I am feeling distress and anguish, so go away." He said to the messenger: "I am not one who goes away until I enter." So she permitted him, and she said: "I am feeling distress and anguish, and I am fearful of what I am afraid of coming upon me." Ibn 'Abbas said to her: "By God, I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: '*'A'isha is in Paradise.*' And the Messenger of God ﷺ was too honored with God to be married to an ember from the embers of Hell." She said: "You have relieved me; may God relieve you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الْمَغَازِي، وَابْنُ عُمَرَ يَسْمَعُهُ، قَالَ حِينَ يَسْمَعُ حَدِيثَهُ: «إِنَّهُ يُحَدِّثُ كَأَنَّهُ شَهِدَ الْقَوْمَ»
entries.isnad_en: From al-Haytham, from 'Amir al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: He used to narrate about the military campaigns while Ibn 'Umar was listening. When he heard his narration, he [Ibn 'Umar] said: "He narrates as though he had been present with the people."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مَغَازِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي حَلَقَةٍ فِيهَا ابْنُ عُمَرَ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّهُ لَيُحَدِّثُ كَأَنَّهُ شَهِدَ الْقَوْمَ»
entries.isnad_en: From Dawud b. Abi Hind, from 'Amir [al-Sha'bi], that he was narrating about the campaigns of the Messenger of God ﷺ in a circle in which was Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: "He narrates as though he had been present with the people."

entries.label: Entry
entries.matn_ar: زُفَرُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَنِيفَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ حَمَّادًا، يَقُولُ: "كُنْتُ إِذَا نَظَرَتُ إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، فَكُلُّ مَنْ رَأَى هَدْيَهُ، يَقُولُ: كَانَ هَدْيُهُ هَدْيَ عَلْقَمَةَ، وَيَقُولُ: مَنْ رَأَى عَلْقَمَةَ، يَقُولُ: كَانَ هَدْيُهُ هَدْيَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَيَقُولُ مَنْ رَأَى هَدْيَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: كَانَ هَدْيُهُ هَدْيَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ"
entries.isnad_en: Zufar said: I heard Abu Hanifa ؓ say:
entries.matn_en: I heard Hammad say: "When I looked at Ibrahim, everyone who saw his demeanor would say: 'His demeanor is the demeanor of 'Alqama.' And whoever saw 'Alqama would say: 'His demeanor is the demeanor of 'Abd Allah.' And whoever saw the demeanor of 'Abd Allah would say: 'His demeanor is the demeanor of the Messenger of God ﷺ.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.matn_ar: أَبُو حَمْزَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ دَاوُدَ، يَقُولُ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي حَنِيفَةَ: "مَنْ أَدْرَكْتَ مِنَ الْكُبَرَاءِ؟ قَالَ: الْقَاسِمَ، وَسَالِمًا، وَطَاوُسًا، وَعِكْرِمَةَ، وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ دِينَارٍ، وَالْحَسَنَ الْبَصْرِيَّ، وَعَمْرَو بْنَ دِينَارٍ، وَأَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ، وَعَطَاءً، وَقَتَادَةَ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَالشَّعْبِيَّ، وَنَافِعًا، وَأَمْثَالَهُمْ"
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hamza al-Ansari said: I heard 'Abd Allah b. Dawud say:
entries.matn_en: I said to Abu Hanifa: "Which of the elders did you meet?" He said: "al-Qasim, Salim, Tawus, 'Ikrima, 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, al-Hasan al-Basri, 'Amr b. Dinar, Abu al-Zubayr, 'Ata', Qatada, Ibrahim, al-Sha'bi, Nafi'', and their like."

sections.title_en: The Book of the Virtue of His Community
sections.title_ar: كِتَابُ فَضْلِ أُمَّتِهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "إذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ أَنْ يَسْجُدُوا، سَجَدَتْ أُمَّتِي مَرَّتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْأُمَمِ طَوِيلًا، قَالَ: فَيُقَالُ: ارْفَعُوا رُءُوسَكُمْ، فَقَدْ جَعَلْتُ عَدْلَكُمُ الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَى فِدَاءَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ"
entries.isnad_en: From Abu Burda, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "On the Day of Resurrection, when they are called to prostrate and are unable to prostrate, my community will prostrate twice for a long time before the [other] nations. Then it will be said: 'Raise your heads, for I have made your equivalent, the Jews and Christians, a ransom for you from the Fire.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar:
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "إذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ، يُعْطَى كُلُّ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى، فَيُقَالُ: هَذَا فِدَاؤُكَ مِنَ النَّارِ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: "إذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ، أَعْطَى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى كُلَّ رَجُلٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأَمَّةِ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ، فَيُقَالُ لَهُ: هَذَا فِدَاؤُكَ مِنَ النَّارِ".

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: "إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ، دُفِعَ إِلَى كُلِّ رَجُلٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: هَذَا فِدَاؤُكَ مِنَ النَّارِ"
entries.isnad_en: From Abu Burda, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en:
"On the Day of Resurrection, every man of the Muslims will be given a man from the Jews and Christians, and it will be said: 'This is your ransom from the Fire.'" In another narration: "On the Day of Resurrection, God Almighty will give every man of this community a man from among the disbelievers, and it will be said to him: 'This is your ransom from the Fire.'"

In another narration: "On the Day of Resurrection, a man from the People of the Book will be handed over to every man of this community, and it will be said to him: 'This is your ransom from the Fire.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمًا لِأَصْحَابِهِ: "أَتَرْضَوْنَ أَنْ تَكُونُوا رُبْعَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ؟ قَالُوا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: أَتَرْضَوْنَ أَنْ تَكُونُوا ثُلُثَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ؟ قَالُوا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: أَتَرْضَوْنَ أَنْ تَكُونُوا نِصْفَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ؟ قَالُوا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: أَبْشِرُوا فَإِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ عِشْرُونَ وَمِائَةُ صَفٍّ، أُمَّتِي مِنْ ذَلِكَ ثَمَانُونَ صَفًّا"
entries.isnad_en: From 'Alqama, from Ibn Burayda, from his father ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said one day to his companions:
entries.matn_en: "Would you be pleased to be a quarter of the people of Paradise?" They said: "Yes." He said: "Would you be pleased to be a third of the people of Paradise?" They said: "Yes." He said: "Would you be pleased to be half of the people of Paradise?" They said: "Yes." He said: "Receive glad tidings, for the people of Paradise are one hundred and twenty rows, and my community is eighty rows of them."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar:
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنَّ أُمَّتِي أُمَّةٌ مَرْحُومَةٌ عَذَابُهَا بِأَيْدِيهَا فِي الدُّنْيَا».

زَادَ فِي الرِّاوَيَةِ: «بِالْقَتْلِ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «إِنَّ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةَ مَرْحُومَةٌ عَذَابُهَا بِأَيْدِيهَا»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu Burda, from his father ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en:
"My community is a community shown mercy; its punishment is in its own hands in this world."

He added in the narration: "through killing." In another narration: "This community is shown mercy; its punishment is in its own hands."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "فَنَاءُ أُمَّتِي بِالطَّعْنِ وَالطَّاعُونِ، قِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، الطَّعْنُ قَدْ عَرَفْنَاهُ، فَمَا الطَّاعُونَ؟ قَالَ: وَخْزُ أَعْدَائِكُمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «وَفِي كُلٍّ شُهَدَاءُ»
entries.isnad_en: From Ziyad, from Yazid b. al-Harith, from Abu Musa ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "The perishing of my community will be by stabbing and plague." It was said: "O Messenger of God, we know stabbing; what is plague?" He said: "The pricking of your enemies from among the jinn." In another narration: "And in each there are martyrs."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "فَنَاءُ أُمَّتِي بِالطَّعْنِ وَالطَّاعُونِ، فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذَا الطَّعْنُ، قَدْ عَلِمْنَاهُ، فَمَا الطَّاعُونَ؟ قَالَ: وَخْزُ أَعْدَائِكُمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ، وَفِي كُلٍّ شَهَادَةٌ"
entries.isnad_en: From Khalid b. 'Alqama, from 'Abd Allah b. al-Harith, from Abu Musa ؓ, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The perishing of my community will be by stabbing and plague." It was said: "O Messenger of God, this stabbing we know; what is plague?" He said: "The pricking of your enemies from among the jinn, and in each there is martyrdom."

sections.title_en: The Book of Foods, Drinks, Drinking Vessels, Sacrificial Animals, Hunting, and Slaughtered Animals
sections.title_ar: كِتَابُ الْأَطْعِمَةِ وَالْأَشْرِبَةِ وَالشُّرْبِ وَالضَّحَايَا وَالصَّيْدِ وَالذَّبَائِحِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا:
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Muharib, from Ibn 'Umar ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade eating every predatory animal with a canine tooth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا:
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي مِخْلَبٍ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Muharib, from Ibn 'Umar ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ, on the day of Khaybar, forbade eating every bird with talons."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ أَكْلِ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الَأَهْلِيَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu Ishaq, from al-Bara', who said:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade eating the meat of domestic donkeys."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا:
entries.matn_ar: «نُهِينَا عَنْ خَشَاشِ الْأَرْضِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Nafi'', from Ibn 'Umar ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "We were forbidden [to eat] the vermin of the earth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ قَتَلَ ضُفْدَعًا، فَعَلَيْهِ شَاةٌ مُحْرِمًا كَانَ أَوْ حَلَالًا»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu al-Zubayr al-Makki, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "Whoever kills a frog owes a sheep, whether he is in a state of ihram or not."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا
entries.matn_ar: "أَنَّهُ أُهْدِيَ لَهَا ضَبٌّ، فَسَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَنَهَاهَا عَنْ أَكْلِهِ، فَجَاءَ سَائِلٌ، فَأَمَرَتْ لَهُ بِهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَتُطْعِمِينَ مَا لَا تَأْكُلِينَ!»
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "A dabb [spiny-tailed lizard] was gifted to her. She asked the Prophet ﷺ, and he forbade her from eating it. Then a beggar came, and she ordered that it be given to him. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Do you feed [others] what you do not eat?!'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا نَبْعَثُ الْكِلَابَ الْمُعَلَّمَةَ، أَفَنَأْكُلُ مِمَّا أَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْنَا؟ فَقَالَ: "إذَا ذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى مَا لَمْ يَشْرِكْهَا كَلْبٌ غَيْرُهَا، قُلْتُ: وَإِنْ قَتَلَ؟ قَالَ: وَإِنْ قَتَلَ، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَحَدُنَا يَرْمِي بِالْمِعْرَاضِ؟ قَالَ: إذَا رَمَيْتَ فَسَمَّيْتَ، فَحَزَقَ فَكُلْ، فَإِنْ أَصَابَ بِعَرْضِهِ فَلَا تَأْكُلْ"
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Hammam, from 'Adi b. Hatim, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ, saying: "O Messenger of God, we send out trained dogs; may we eat of what they catch for us?" He said: "If you mentioned the name of God Almighty, so long as no other dog joined them." I said: "Even if it killed [the game]?" He said: "Even if it killed." I said: "O Messenger of God, one of us throws the mi'rad [a headless, pointed arrow/stick]?" He said: "If you throw it having said God's name, and it pierces [the game], eat; but if it strikes with its flat side, do not eat."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا جَزَرَ عَنْهُ الْمَاءَ فَكُلْ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Atiyya, from Abu Sa'id, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "What the water has receded from [leaving it behind], eat."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتَ عَجْرَدٍ، تَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «أَكْثَرُ جُنْدِ اللَّهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ الْجَرَادُ، لَا آكُلُهُ وَلَا أُحَرِّمُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: He said: I heard 'A'isha bint 'Ajrad say:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Most of God's soldiers on earth are locusts. I neither eat them nor forbid them."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ،
entries.matn_ar: "أَنَّ بَعِيرًا مِنْ إِبِلِ الصَّدَقَةِ نَدَّ فَطَلَبُوهُ، فَلَمَّا أَعْيَاهُمْ أَنْ يَأْخُذُوهُ رَمَاهُ رَجُلٌ بِسَهْمٍ، فَأَصَابَ مَقْتَلَهُ، فَسَأَلُوا النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَمَرَ بِأَكْلِهِ، وَقَالَ: «إِنَّ لَهَا أَوَابِدَ كَأَوَابِدِ الْوُحُوشِ؛ فَإِذَا خَشِيتُمْ مِنْهَا فَاصْنَعُوا مِثْلَمَا صَنَعْتُمْ بِهَذَا الْبَعِيرِ، ثُمَّ كُلُوهُ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: إِنَّ بَعِيرًا مِنْ إِبِلِ الصَّدَقَةِ نَدَّ، فَرَمَاهُ رَجُلٌ بِسَهْمٍ فَقَتَلَهُ، فَسُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ أَكْلِهِ، فَقَالَ: «كُلُوهُ، فَإِنَّ لَهَا أَوَابِدَ كَأَوَابِدِ الْوَحْشِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Sa'id, from 'Abaya b. Rifa'a, from Rafi' b. Khadij:
entries.matn_en: "A camel from the charity camels bolted, and they pursued it. When they were unable to catch it, a man shot it with an arrow and struck a fatal spot. They asked the Prophet ﷺ, and he ordered that it be eaten, and said: 'These [animals] have wild traits like the wild traits of wild beasts; so if you fear [harm] from any of them, do with it as you did with this camel, then eat it.'" In another narration: A camel from the charity camels bolted, and a man shot it with an arrow and killed it. The Prophet ﷺ was asked about eating it, and he said: "Eat it, for these have wild traits like the wild traits of wild beasts."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا،
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنِ الْمُجْثَمَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Nafi'', from Ibn 'Umar ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "The Prophet ﷺ forbade the mujaththama [an animal tied up and used for target practice]."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ: «يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ غُنَيْمَةَ كَانَتْ لَهَا رَاعِيَةٌ، فَخَافَتْ عَلَى شَاةٍ مِنْهَا الْمَوْتَ، فَذَبَحَتْهَا بِمَرْوَةٍ؟ فَأَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِأَكْلِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: From Nafi'', from Ibn 'Umar ؓ:
entries.matn_en: Ka'b b. Malik came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of God, [a woman] had a small flock with a shepherdess. She feared death for one of the sheep, so she slaughtered it with a sharp stone (marwa)." The Prophet ﷺ ordered him to eat it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهِ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar:
«خَرَجَ غُلَامٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ قَبلَ أُحُدٍ، فَمَرَّ فِي طَرِيقِهِ، فَاصْطَادَ أَرْنَبًا فَلَمْ يَجِدْ مَا يَذْبَحُهَا، فَذَبَحَهَا بِحَجَرٍ، فَجَاءَ بِهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَدْ عَلَّقَهَا بِيَدِهِ، فَأَمَرَهُ بِأَكْلِهَا»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَصَابَ أَرْنَبَيْنِ، فَذَبَحَهُمَا بِمِرْوَةٍ يَعْنِي: الْحَجَرَ، «فَأَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِأَكْلِهَا».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: أَصَابَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي سَلَمَةَ أَرْنَبًا بِأُحُدٍ، فَلَمْ يَجِدْ سِكِّينًا، فَذَبَحَهَا بِحَجَرٍ، «فَأَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِأَكْلِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: From al-Haytham, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en:
"A young man of the Ansar went out before [the Battle of] Uhud, and on his way he hunted a rabbit. He found nothing to slaughter it with, so he slaughtered it with a stone. He brought it to the Messenger of God ﷺ, having hung it by his hand, and he ordered him to eat it." In another narration: A man caught two rabbits and slaughtered them with a marwa, meaning a stone, "and the Prophet ﷺ ordered him to eat them."

In another narration: A man of Banu Salama caught a rabbit at Uhud and did not find a knife, so he slaughtered it with a stone, "and the Prophet ﷺ ordered him to eat it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَكَلَ مِنْ ذَبِيحَةِ امْرَأَةٍ، وَنَهَى عَنْ قَتْلِ الْمَرْأَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Ibrahim, from 'Alqama, from 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ ate from the slaughtered animal of a woman, and he forbade the killing of women."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُخَوَّلِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ الْبَطِينِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا مِنْ أَيَّامٍ أَفْضَلُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَيَّامِ عَشْرِ الْأَضْحَى، فَأَكْثِرُوا فِيهِنَّ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى»
entries.isnad_en: From Mukhawwal b. Rashid, from Muslim al-Batin, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "There are no days more excellent with God than the days of the ten [days] of al-Adha, so increase in them the remembrance of God Almighty."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ جَبَلَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «جَرَتِ السُّنَّةِ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْأُضْحِيَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Jabala, from Ibn 'Umar ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The sunna from the Messenger of God ﷺ has been established regarding the sacrificial animal (udhiya)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَابِطٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ:
entries.matn_ar:
«أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ضَحَّى بِكَبْشَيْنِ أَشْعَرَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ، أَحَدُهُمَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ، وَالْآخَرُ عَنْ مَنْ شَهِدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مِنْ أُمَّتِهِ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ نَحْوُهُ، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: From al-Haytham, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sabit, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "The Prophet ﷺ sacrificed two rams, long-haired and white-speckled; one on behalf of himself, and the other on behalf of whoever of his community testified that there is no god but God." In another narration, similar to it, without mentioning Jabir b. 'Abd Allah ؓ.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَالشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ نِيَارٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ ذَبَحَ شَاةً قَبْلَ الصَّلَاةِ، فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ: «تُجْزِي عَنْكَ وَلَا تُجْزِي عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Ibrahim and al-Sha'bi, from Abu Burda b. Niyar ؓ:
entries.matn_en: that he slaughtered a sheep before the prayer and mentioned that to the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "It suffices for you, but it will not suffice for anyone after you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، وَحَمَّادٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمَا حَدَّثَاهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ: «إِنَّمَا نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْأَضَاحِي فَوْقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ، لِيُوَسِّعَ مُوسِعُكُمْ عَلَى فَقِيرِكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Alqama b. Marthad and Hammad, who both narrated to him from 'Abd Allah b. Burayda, from his father ؓ, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "I only forbade you [to keep] the meat of sacrificial animals beyond three days so that the well-off among you might be generous to your poor."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ:
entries.matn_ar: "أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ، وَقَرَّبَ إِلَيْهِ خُبْزًا وَخَلًّا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَانَا عَنِ التَّكْلِفَةِ، وَلَوْلَا ذَلِكَ لَتَكَلَّفْتُ لَكُمْ، وَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ: «نِعْمَ الإِدَامُ الْخَلُّ»
entries.isnad_en: From Muharib b. Dithar, from Jabir ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "[A man] entered upon him, and he brought bread and vinegar close to him, and then said: 'The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade us from going to [excessive] trouble [for guests], and were it not for that, I would have gone to trouble for you. And I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "What an excellent condiment vinegar is."'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «نِعْمَ الْإِدَامُ الْخَلُّ»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "What an excellent condiment vinegar is."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «الْكَافِرُ يَأْكُلُ فِي سَبْعَةِ أَمْعَاءٍ، وَالْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: From Nafi'', from Ibn 'Umar ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "The disbeliever eats in seven intestines, and the believer eats in one intestine."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَمَّا أَنَا فَلَا آكُلُ مُتَّكِئًا، وَأَشْرَبُ كَمَا يَشْرَبُ الْعَبْدُ، وَأَعْبُدُ رَبِّي حَتَّى يَأْتِيَنِي الْيَقِينُ»
entries.isnad_en: From 'Ali b. al-Aqmar, from Abu Juhayfa ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: "As for me, I do not eat reclining, and I drink as a servant drinks, and I worship my Lord until certainty [death] comes to me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ نَشْرَبَ فِي آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَأَنْ نَأْكُلَ فِيهَا، وَأَنْ نَلْبَسَ الْحَرِيرَ وَالدِّيبَاجَ، قَالَ: هِيَ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَلَكُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ"
entries.isnad_en: From Hammad, from Hudhayfa ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade us to drink from vessels of gold and silver, to eat from them, and to wear silk and brocade. He said: 'They are for the polytheists in this world, and for you in the Hereafter.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: نَزَلْنَا مَعَ حُذَيْفَةَ عَلَى دِهْقَانَ بِالْمَدَائِنِ، فَأَتَى بِطَعَامٍ فَطَعِمْنَا، ثُمَّ دَعَا حُذَيْفَةُ بِشَرَابٍ فَأَتَى بِشَرَابٍ فِي إِنَاءٍ فِضَّةٍ، فَضَرَبَ بِهِ وَجْهَهُ، فَسَاءَنَا مَا صَنَعَ، فَقَالَ: أَتَدْرُونَ لِمَ صَنَعْتُ بِهِ هَذَا؟ فَقُلْنَا: لَا، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي نَزَلَتُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْعَامِ الْمَاضِي، فَدَعَوْتُ بِشَرَابٍ، فَأَتَانِي بِشَرَابٍ فِيهِ، فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَانَا أَنْ نَأْكُلَ فِي آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَأَنْ نَشْرَبَ فِيهَا، وَأَنْ نَلْبَسَ الْحَرِيرَ وَالدِّيبَاجَ، فَإِنَّهَا لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَهِيَ لَنَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Muslim, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: We stayed with Hudhayfa at the house of a dihqan [Persian landowner] in al-Mada'in. Food was brought and we ate. Then Hudhayfa asked for a drink, and a drink was brought in a silver vessel. He struck [the man's] face with it, and what he did distressed us. He said: "Do you know why I did this to him?" We said: "No." He said: "I stayed with him last year and asked for a drink, and he brought me a drink in it. I informed him that 'the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade us to eat from vessels of gold and silver, to drink from them, and to wear silk and brocade, for they are for the polytheists in this world, and they are for us in the Hereafter.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: اسْتَسْقَى حُذَيْفَةُ بْنُ الْيَمَانِ مِنْ دِهْقَانَ، فَأَتَى فِي إِنَاءٍ فِضَّةٍ، فَأَخَذَ الْإِنَاءَ، فَضَرَبَ بِهِ وَجْهَهُ، وَقَالَ: «إِنَّ رَسَولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى أَنْ نَشْرَبَ فِي آنِيَةِ الْفِضَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Abu Farwa, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: Hudhayfa b. al-Yaman asked a dihqan for water, and it was brought in a silver vessel. He took the vessel, struck his face with it, and said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade us to drink from silver vessels."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا مَعَ حُذَيْفَةَ بِالْمَدَائِنِ، فَاسْتَسْقَى دِهْقَانًا، فَأَتَاهُ بِهِ فِي جَامٍ فِضَّةٍ، فَرَمَى بِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: "إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنْ آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَقَالَ: هِيَ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَكُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ"
entries.isnad_en: From al-Hakam, from Ibn Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were with Hudhayfa in al-Mada'in, and he asked a dihqan for water. He brought it to him in a silver bowl, and [Hudhayfa] threw it, then said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade vessels of gold and silver, and said: 'They are for them in this world and for you in the Hereafter.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا،
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ»
entries.isnad_en: From Nafi'', from Ibn 'Umar ؓ:
entries.matn_en: "The Prophet ﷺ forbade [fermenting drinks in] the dubba' [gourd vessel] and the hantam [glazed jar]."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar:
«نَهَيْنَاكُمْ عَنْ زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ، فَقَدْ أُذِنَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِ أُمِّهِ، فَزُورُوهَا، وَلَا تَقُولُوا هُجْرًا، وَعَنْ لُحُومِ الْأَضَاحِي، أَنْ تُمْسِكُوهَا فَوْقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ، وَإِنَّا نَهَيْنَاكُمْ، لِيُوَسِّعَ مُوسِرُكُمْ عَلَى فَقِيرِكُمْ، وَالْآنَ قَدْ وَسَّعَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ، فَكُلُوا وَتَزَوَّدُوا، وَعَنِ الشُّرْبِ فِي الْحَنْتَمِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «وَعَنِ النَّقِيرِ، وَالدُّبَّاءِ، فَاشْرَبُوا فِي كُلِّ ظَرْفٍ شِئْتُمْ، فَإِنَّ الظَّرْفَ لَا يُحِلُّ شَيْئًا، وَلَا يُحَرِّمُهُ، وَلَا تَشْرَبُوا مُسْكِرًا».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّا نَهَيْنَاكُمْ عَنْ ثَلاثَةٍ: عَنْ زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ فَزُورُوهَا، وَنَهَيْنَاكُمْ أَنْ تُمْسِكُوا لُحُومَ الْأَضَاحِي فَوْقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ، فَأَمْسِكُوهَا وَتَزَوَّدُوا، وَإِنَّمَا نَهَيْنَاكُمْ، لِيُوَسِّعَ غَنِيُّكُمْ عَلَى فَقِيرِكُمْ، وَنَهَيْنَاكُمْ أَنْ تَشْرَبُوا فِي الدُّبَّاءِ، وَالْمُزَفَّتِ، فَاشْرَبُوا فِيمَا بَدَا لَكُمْ، فَإِنَّ الظَّرْفَ لَا يُحِلُّ شَيْئًا، وَلَا يُحَرِّمُهُ، وَلَا تَشْرَبُوا مُسْكِرًا".

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ نَحْوَهُ، وَفِيهِ: وَعَنِ النَّبِيذِ فِي الدُّبَّاءِ، وَالْحَنْتَمِ، وَالْمُزَفَّتِ، فَاشْرَبُوا فِي كُلِّ ظَرْفٍ، وَلَا تَشْرَبُوا مُسْكِرًا"
entries.isnad_en: From 'Alqama, from Sulayman b. Burayda, from his father ؓ, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en:
"I [had] forbidden you from visiting graves, but Muhammad ﷺ has been permitted to visit the grave of his mother, so visit them, and do not utter anything vile. And [I forbade you] from keeping the meat of sacrificial animals beyond three days. I forbade you so that the well-off among you might be generous to your poor; now God has granted you abundance, so eat and take provisions. And [I forbade you] from drinking in the hantam and the muzaffat [pitch-coated vessel]." In another narration: "And from the naqir [hollowed palm-trunk vessel] and the dubba'. So drink in any vessel you wish, for the vessel neither makes anything lawful nor unlawful, but do not drink any intoxicant."
